actionLevel.title: Operation Levels
actionLevel.description: Each operation belongs to exactly one level. Levels decide which operations the built-in templates contain, and who may grant them to others. An operation with no level is excluded from every template, so nobody can perform it.
actionLevel.pendingChanges_one: 1 change is not published yet — it takes effect after publishing
actionLevel.pendingChanges_other: {{count}} changes are not published yet — they take effect after publishing
actionLevel.draftFailed: Could not prepare the change draft. Try again.
actionLevel.descriptionMore: To grant a template to someone else, your own template must include the Manage Permission operation and rank above the template you are granting. A template of the same level can only be granted when it has same-level granting turned on.
actionLevel.activeHint: Turning this off removes the operation from every permission template.
actionLevel.unassignedEmpty: No unassigned operations. Anything dropped here is removed from every template and nobody can perform it.

model.name: Template Name

model.deleteBlockedByGrants: {{count}} grant(s) still use this template. Move them to another template before deleting it.
model.deleteBlockedByResidual: Visibility projections or relationship residuals still reference this template. Reconcile them before deleting it.
model.deleteBlocked: Grant references or visibility residuals remain. Remove or move the grants, or finish reconciliation first.
model.deleteRequirement: Before deleting, move every grant that uses it to another template. Disabling it does not require this.
model.description: Tick the operations this template covers. A custom template contains only what you tick — it does not automatically include lower-level operations. Its level is the highest operation in the selection.
model.activeHint: Switched off, it can no longer be granted; existing grants are unaffected.
model.allowSameLevelHint: Holders of this template can grant a template of the same level to others. Only Owner has this on by default.
model.allowSameLevelUnavailable: Select the Manage Permission operation first.
model.descriptionBuiltin: Built-in templates cannot be edited. They accumulate by level: Viewer = level 1, Editor = levels 1–2, Manager = levels 1–3, Owner = everything.
